stories.title: Upside Foods can now make a million pounds of chicken a year without killing any animals
stories.summary: Upside Foods says it can produce one million pounds of cultivated chicken a year without slaughtering animals. The company says its product can now match the price range of high-quality organic chicken, a marked shift from the first lab-grown hamburger’s reported $300,000 cost in 2013.

links.headline: Upside Foods can now make a million pounds of chicken a year without killing any animals
links.excerpt: The first ever lab-grown hamburger cost $300,000 to make in 2013. Upside Foods says its cultivated chicken can now match the price range of “really high-quality organic chicken."

stories.title: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
stories.summary: Proton has released a desktop version of Lumo, its privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, for Windows, Mac and Linux. The app can automate tasks across files and connected applications while giving users granular control over what the AI may access.

links.headline: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
links.excerpt: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.
